summary: Oregon Department of Forestry lookout on Dixie Mountain in Multnomah County; a 1957 newspaper caption shows its tower. No source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Not on a July 2026 list of standing Oregon lookouts, and that list warns its information may be out of date.

events.note: May 19, 1957 newspaper caption (The Sunday Oregonian) under an aerial photo of the lookout tower.

notes_for_editor: Thin record: one Forest Lookouts page with a 1957 caption quoted second-hand from The Sunday Oregonian, plus the July 2026 standing list. The original newspaper was not checked. Dixie Butte in the Malheur National Forest (data/towers/or/us-or-dixie-butte.json and data/research/us-or-dixie-butte.json) is a different lookout and was not used. No NHLR or FFLOS Oregon entry under Dixie Mountain appears in the local crawl cache. The record's coordinates and county were not checked beyond the Forest Lookouts page heading. Nothing here says whether the tower stands.
